name: calculate
description: Evaluate a mathematical expression accurately (supports +, -, *, /, %, ^, parentheses, and common math functions like sqrt, abs, round, floor, ceil, min, max, pow, log, sin, cos, tan, pi, e).

expression.description: Mathematical expression to evaluate, e.g. '(1250 * 1.08) / 12' or 'sqrt(144) + 2^5'.
